evidence.detail: remove_extraneous_hyphens only strips leading/trailing hyphens; mid-name hyphens are untouched by design
Tests show hyphens are intentionally kept in some names (Elves-N-Taxes3, hyper-cascade-v5-for-nuutz) while the issue wants them removed in others (this-is-a-deck-name, S22 Cadaverslide-V26)
Issue body itself asks 'can we come up with a rule?' — no rule exists yet and the comment notes partial mitigation from not-lowercasing

triage.notes: Decision needed: when should a hyphen be treated as a word separator (and removed/replaced by a space) vs. a legitimate part of a compound name? The answer determines whether to touch remove_extraneous_hyphens or add a new step.
